loaderSaveAudit.reservedManagedAssemblyIdentityRule: External mod packages must not use engine-owned assembly identities. Loader and SDK builder reject Hecton8.*, Unity*, Assembly-CSharp, System, mscorlib, and netstandard names by file name or assembly metadata identity.
loaderSaveAudit.runtimeBoundary: Loader and SaveState are cold-path/managed-boundary contracts. They do not authorize direct SignalBus, NativeArray, DataVault, Unity object, or first-party save-owner mutation.

eventSubscriptionAudit.publicRoute: HectonAPI.Events only; HectonEventBus is internal first-party infrastructure and has no public static bus member surface. HectonModHooks publication methods are internal first-party infrastructure. HectonGameEvents managed payload classes and members are internal-only first-party legacy payloads, not SDK event DTOs.
eventSubscriptionAudit.subscriberScopeRule: Subscribe, SubscribeNative, SubscribeProjected, OnPlayerSpawned, and OnBiomeChanged require active ModExecutionScope before envelope-only quarantine checks; explicit subscriberId must match the active mod id. Internal unmanaged/native/projected event bridge routes and private channel implementations reject anonymous subscribers before token creation. Publish requires active ModExecutionScope before envelope-only quarantine checks and rejects engine-owned command, result, projection, and lifecycle payload types when managed events are reopened. Unsubscribe rejects tokens owned by a different active mod. Direct HectonEventSubscription.Dispose validates active mod ownership for mod-owned tokens before unsubscribing. HectonGameEvents payloads must not expose public Unity object, survival-system, or asset handles.
eventSubscriptionAudit.lifetimeRule: Every subscription token returned to a mod must be disposed during IHectonMod.OnUnload under the owning mod execution scope; direct Dispose and HectonAPI.Events.Unsubscribe both validate owner scope for mod-owned tokens. DisableManagedMod must isolate native, unmanaged, and projected subscribers by subscriber id.
